summary: The WorksheetAssignStudentsEditAll class is part of the HSPnet framework and is responsible for managing the assignment of students through a web-based interface. It includes functionalities for editing and sorting assignments, handling user preferences and prerequisites, and displaying various student assignment options.
purpose: To facilitate the management and assignment of students within academic workflows, providing functionalities for editing, sorting, and managing assignment details, preferences, and prerequisites through a web-based interface.
